component.name: DiaScan
component.summary: Scan slide magazines with Reflecta DigitDia and PIE scanners

description.p: Native Linux replacement for CyberView X5 for magazine slide scanners such as the Reflecta DigitDia 4000, 5000 and 6000.

ul.li: Automatic scanning of entire slide magazines with empty-slot detection
Automatic exposure, auto crop, auto levels and faded-colour restoration
Colour balance, curves and levels, sharpening and grain reduction
Slides, colour negatives and black and white film
48-bit TIFF and PNG, 24-bit TIFF and JPEG output
